page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 8 physical cores, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not bundle local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs. Based on the hardware profile, advanced CPU instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA), are not exposed or available on this instance.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from neighboring tenants. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a standard resource balance, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require predictable CPU performance without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators or local NVMe drives. Suitable workloads include general-purpose web serving, basic application servers, and moderate database hosting where external storage is utilized.
